0022600002.text: Both the Philadelphia 76ers and New York Knicks are opening their 2026-27 seasons, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the visiting 76ers a 45% chance to win. Ariel Hukporti is out with a ruptured Achilles for Philadelphia, while Adem Bona, Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade, Dominick Barlow and Tacko Fall are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and New York's Josh Hart is also day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, but the 76ers lost the 2025-26 playoffs series 0-4, including a 144-114 loss in Philadelphia on May 10.
